## Module to write
path: StarterPlayerScripts/FeatureVerifyClient.client.luau
purpose: Feature: Add executable checks and fix failures for: the SHOP button opens a panel listing every Upgrades entry with price and affordability, and buying Dropper 2 for 10 works once; the rebirth altar appears at 5000 cash or when all upgrades are owned, and rebirth applies the multiplier and resets cash and upgrades; the plaza TOP TYCOONS board lists Cash and Rebirths; the tutorial arrow and banner appear after the first claim and advance on the first purchase. Mark each feature verified when its checks pass. -- Client-side probe that stays inert unless the verify remotes exist (it WaitForChilds them with a timeout and exits on nil). On request from the server it inspects the player's own UI and replies with plain data. For SHOP, it finds the SHOP button in PlayerGui, activates it, and returns whether the panel is visible plus the list of cards (UpgradeId, price text, Affordable attribute). For TUTORIAL, it returns whether the banner and arrow are visible. It sends no gameplay intent to the server. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: feature_verified_shop, feature_verified_rebirth, feature_verified_board, feature_verified_tutorial.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/FeatureChecksConfig.luau, StarterPlayerScripts/ShopUi.client.luau, StarterPlayerScripts/TutorialGuide.client.luau

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~10-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds, and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. Otherwise the loop is never exercised.
- Keep tutorial text consistent with the actual flow (e.g. don't say "walk to a gate" if auto-claim happens within seconds).
- Feedback should be audible and visible: use verified sound ids from the shared asset table, not weak built-in rbxasset wavs. Add particles or ambient sparkle, and set the bloom threshold low enough that Neon parts glow.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value; a counter at 2x its expected value (e.g. 12 vs 6) means a double init or double build, so check for it.
- Each builder/init function must be called exactly once from the entry script. If two modules both build the same thing (e.g. plaza and plot builders both building themes), assign ownership to one.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.
- Define the data shape that a builder module returns (field names such as origin, gate, spawn) once, and have consumers use those exact fields. Do not add `a or b` fallbacks for guessed names.
- Never let persistence (DataStore load) block gameplay: use a short timeout and fall back to defaults so the claim/start flow proceeds even if loading is slow or fails in Studio.
- Keep costs and tunables in one source of truth. Remove stale Config values left over from earlier designs so they can't contradict the current spec, and avoid grey colors in constants.
- Sounds and particles are created where they are played. For per-event effects, the server only fires a remote or counter, and the client script (or a server-created Sound/ParticleEmitter in the scene) must actually instantiate the Sound and ParticleEmitter instances.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError (e.g. cannot serve a path, or "Network action ExecuteLuau.runCode failed") is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase, earlier auto-claim, closer gates) instead of only adding more code.
- When the spec changes the flow (e.g. from auto-assign to claim), rewrite the entry script (Game.server) to require and wire the new modules, and delete the old flow's logic (slots, teleport on join). Updating only the new modules leaves the old behaviour running.
- After a redesign, check that every module is required by the entry script and that its init function is called exactly once. Unwired modules never run, and their counters never fire.

```luau
-- FeatureVerifyClient: inert client probe. Stays idle unless the server created the verify remotes.
-- It only reads the player's own UI and replies with plain data; it sends no gameplay intent.
-- Telemetry counters (feature_verified_*) are bumped by the server, because ForgeTelemetry is a no-op on the client.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then
	return
end

local cfgModule = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FeatureChecksConfig", 10)
if not cfgModule then
	return
end
local Config = require(cfgModule)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(Config.RemoteFolderName, 10)
if not remotes then
	return
end
local requestRemote = remotes:WaitForChild(Config.Remotes.Request, 10)
local responseRemote = remotes:WaitForChild(Config.Remotes.Response, 10)
if not requestRemote or not responseRemote then
	return
end
if not requestRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not responseRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
	return
end

local Gui = Config.Gui

local function getPlayerGui(): Instance?
	return player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
end

local function guiVisible(inst: Instance?): boolean
	local cur = inst
	while cur do
		if cur:IsA("GuiObject") and not cur.Visible then
			return false
		end
		if cur:IsA("ScreenGui") and not cur.Enabled then
			return false
		end
		if cur:IsA("LayerCollector") then
			return true
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return inst ~= nil
end

local function findByName(root: Instance?, name: string): Instance?
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	return root:FindFirstChild(name, true)
end

local function collectText(root: Instance): string
	local parts = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
			table.insert(parts, d.Text)
		end
	end
	if root:IsA("TextLabel") or root:IsA("TextButton") then
		table.insert(parts, root.Text)
	end
	return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

local function tryActivate(btn: Instance): boolean
	local fs = (getfenv() :: any).firesignal
	if type(fs) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		if btn:IsA("GuiButton") then
			fs(btn.Activated)
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if btn:IsA("GuiButton") then
			fs(btn.MouseButton1Click)
		end
	end)
	return ok
end

local function leaderValue(name: string): number?
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local v = ls and ls:FindFirstChild(name)
	if v and (v:IsA("IntValue") or v:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return v.Value
	end
	return nil
end

local function probeShop(): { [string]: any }
	local pg = getPlayerGui()
	local button = findByName(pg, Gui.ShopButtonName)
	local data: { [string]: any } = { buttonFound = button ~= nil }
	if not pg then
		data.cards = {}
		return data
	end
	local panel = findByName(pg, Gui.ShopPanelName)
	if button then
		data.activated = tryActivate(button)
		task.wait(0.4)
		panel = findByName(pg, Gui.ShopPanelName) or panel
	end
	data.panelExists = panel ~= nil
	data.panelVisible = panel ~= nil and guiVisible(panel)
	local cards = {}
	local scope = panel or pg
	for _, d in ipairs(scope:GetDescendants()) do
		local id = d:GetAttribute(Gui.ShopCardUpgradeIdAttr)
		if id ~= nil then
			local priceText = ""
			for _, c in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
				if c:IsA("TextLabel") or c:IsA("TextButton") then
					if string.find(c.Text, "%$") or string.find(c.Text, "%d") then
						priceText = priceText .. c.Text .. " "
					end
				end
			end
			table.insert(cards, {
				UpgradeId = tostring(id),
				priceText = priceText,
				price = d:GetAttribute(Gui.ShopCardPriceAttr),
				Affordable = d:GetAttribute(Gui.ShopCardAffordableAttr),
			})
		end
	end
	data.cards = cards
	data.cardCount = #cards
	return data
end

local function attrOnAny(attr: string): boolean?
	local sources: { Instance? } = { player, getPlayerGui() }
	for _, s in ipairs(sources) do
		if s and s:GetAttribute(attr) ~= nil then
			return s:GetAttribute(attr) == true
		end
	end
	local pg = getPlayerGui()
	if pg then
		for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:GetAttribute(attr) ~= nil then
				return d:GetAttribute(attr) == true
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function nameSearchVisible(root: Instance?, needle: string): boolean
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if string.find(string.lower(d.Name), needle) then
			if d:IsA("GuiObject") and guiVisible(d) then
				return true
			elseif d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 0.99 then
				return true
			elseif d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Enabled then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function probeTutorial(): { [string]: any }
	local bannerAttr = attrOnAny(Gui.TutorialBannerAttr)
	local arrowAttr = attrOnAny(Gui.TutorialArrowAttr)
	local pg = getPlayerGui()
	local banner = bannerAttr
	if banner == nil then
		banner = nameSearchVisible(pg, "banner")
	end
	local arrow = arrowAttr
	if arrow == nil then
		arrow = nameSearchVisible(pg, "arrow")
			or nameSearchVisible(Workspace.CurrentCamera, "arrow")
			or nameSearchVisible(Workspace, "tutorialarrow")
	end
	return { bannerVisible = banner == true, arrowVisible = arrow == true }
end

local function probeBoard(): { [string]: any }
	local board = Workspace:FindFirstChild(Config.Workspace.BoardName, true)
	local data: { [string]: any } = { boardFound = board ~= nil }
	if board then
		local text = ""
		for _, d in ipairs(board:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("SurfaceGui") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
				text = text .. " " .. collectText(d)
			end
		end
		local lower = string.lower(text)
		data.hasTitle = string.find(lower, string.lower(Config.Workspace.BoardTitle), 1, true) ~= nil
		data.hasCash = string.find(lower, "cash", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(text, "%$") ~= nil
		data.hasRebirths = string.find(lower, "rebirth", 1, true) ~= nil
	end
	return data
end

local function probeRebirth(): { [string]: any }
	local altar = Workspace:FindFirstChild(Config.Workspace.AltarName, true)
	local pg = getPlayerGui()
	return {
		altarFound = altar ~= nil,
		rebirthButtonFound = findByName(pg, Gui.RebirthButtonName) ~= nil,
		cash = leaderValue(Config.Stats.Cash),
		rebirths = leaderValue(Config.Stats.Rebirths),
	}
end

local probes: { [string]: () -> { [string]: any } } = {
	shop = probeShop,
	tutorial = probeTutorial,
	board = probeBoard,
	rebirth = probeRebirth,
}

local busy = false
requestRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(a: any, b: any)
	local feature: any, reqId: any
	if type(a) == "table" then
		feature = a.feature or a.kind or a.name
		reqId = a.id or a.requestId
	else
		feature = a
		reqId = b
	end
	if type(feature) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local probe = probes[feature]
	if not probe then
		return
	end
	if busy then
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	busy = true
	local ok, result = pcall(probe)
	busy = false
	local data: { [string]: any } = ok and result or { error = tostring(result) }
	data.requestId = reqId
	data.ok = ok
	responseRemote:FireServer(feature, data)
end)
```
